description: This PHP source file defines the StripeSubscriptionController class, which handles Stripe webhook events related to subscriptions, invoices, and refunds within the Goteo project. It processes incoming webhook requests, manages investments, and interacts with Stripe API objects.

classes.name: StripeSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller class handling Stripe webhook events for subscriptions, invoices, and refunds, managing investments accordingly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Stripe client and investment repository.

methods.name: subscriptionsWebhook
methods.description: Handles incoming Stripe webhook requests, processes invoice payments and refunds.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes Stripe charge refunds, cancels related investments.

methods.name: processInvoice
methods.description: Processes Stripe invoices, creates or updates investments based on invoice data.
